title: fscale facts --json output
description: The repo facts printed by `fscale facts --json`. Paths are relative to the repo root and always use forward slashes. All lists are sorted.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this format. Changes only on a breaking change.

packageManager.description: The JavaScript package manager of the repo root, from the packageManager field of the root package.json or else from a root lockfile. Null when the root has none; see packageManagers for the projects.

packageManagers.description: Every package manager in use: the root's and each project's.

lockfiles.description: Lockfiles found at the repo root.

languages.description: Languages detected from marker files, at the root and in every project.

tools.description: Build and workspace tools detected from marker files at the repo root.

commands.description: Commands to run from the repo root, for each of the root package.json scripts build, test, lint and typecheck that exists. A test, lint or typecheck script that watches for changes gives way to its run-once sibling (<step>:run, <step>:ci or <step>:once).

projects.description: The projects of the repo, sorted by name: the root, workspace members, and projects found in subfolders.

name.description: The name from the project's manifest, or else the name of its folder. "." for a project at the repo root whose manifest gives no name.

root.description: Repo-relative folder with forward slashes. "." is the repo root.

source.description: How the project was found: it is the repo root, a workspace file at the root lists it, or a marker file was found in a subfolder.

packageManager.description: The project's package manager. Null when a Node project names none and has no lockfile.

lockfiles.description: Names of the lockfiles in the project's folder.

tools.description: Linters, test runners and other tools detected from config files and dependencies in the project's folder.

install.description: Installs the project's dependencies: '<package manager> install' for a Node project that is not a workspace member, and for a Python project the command for its environment (ADR 0022).

commands.description: Commands to run from the project's folder: package scripts first, then commands worked out from tool config files. A test, lint or typecheck script that watches for changes gives way to its run-once sibling (<step>:run, <step>:ci or <step>:once).

dependsOn.description: Names of other projects of the same kind in this repo that this one depends on.

interpreter.description: Python projects only: the interpreter their commands run with, and why (ADR 0022).

source.description: venv: a .venv or venv folder in the project. uv, poetry, pipenv: the project's manager picks the environment. active: the virtual environment named by VIRTUAL_ENV. path: no virtual environment was found, so python from the PATH.

command.description: What each command starts with, for example '.venv/bin/python -m', 'uv run' or 'python -m'.

detail.description: Where the interpreter came from, for people.

warnings.description: Things that were skipped, such as a marker file that is not valid JSON, and things that may go wrong, such as a test script that watches for changes and has no run-once sibling.

notes.description: Sorted. Things worth knowing that need no action, such as a test script that watches for changes and is replaced by its run-once sibling (test:run). Always printed; not required here, so that version 2 output from before the field was added stays valid.

graph.description: The project graph, as fscale graph --json prints its nodes and edges (ADR 0032). Its warnings are in warnings.

nodes.description: Projects first, then shared nodes, each sorted by path.

id.description: <kind>:<path> for a project (python:backend/auth), shared:<path> for a shared folder or file.

type.description: project: a project of fscale facts. shared: a folder or file that projects use and that belongs to no project; a change there affects only the projects that use it.

path.description: Repo-relative, forward slashes; . is the repo root.

kind.description: For a project: node, python, rust or go. For a shared node: folder or file.

name.description: For a project: its name in fscale facts.

from.description: Id of the node that depends on to: a change in to affects from.

sources.description: The evidence for the edge, most trusted first (lowest tier first).

source.description: dependency: a dependency on another project by name. requirements, pyproject, package-json, cargo: a local path in that manifest. dockerfile: a COPY or ADD. compose-build: a Compose build context outside the project. compose-depends-on: depends_on between two services that are projects. shared-input: a .env.example, Compose file or OpenAPI spec the project reads. python-import, js-import: an import read with tree-sitter. dynamic-import: a Python import of a module chosen at run time; the importer depends on every other Python project.

tier.description: 1 manifests, 2 Docker, Compose and shared inputs, 3 imports, 4 dynamic imports.

file.description: Repo-relative file the evidence is in.

detail.description: What was found: the line, or a sentence.
